name: legislation.gov.uk API
tagline: UK primary and secondary legislation as structured XML and data
description: Official API for UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk, providing access to primary and secondary legislation as structured data (including Akoma Ntoso/XML). Supports retrieval of acts, statutory instruments, and related legislative content for legal research and applications.

auth.details: No authentication required for public access.

use_cases: fetch full text of a UK Act by year and chapter
retrieve statutory instrument as structured XML
list legislation by type and year
get table of contents for an Act
